notes: Atticus halosulfuron-methyl 75% WDG (EPA 91234-31; Stadia is an alternate brand name of A304.01, same active as Permit/Sandea). Group 2 ALS. Nutsedge + broadleaf PRE/POST in field corn, pumpkins/winter squash and tomatoes; 30-day PHI, 12 h REI. Fresh-market pumpkin/squash 1/2-3/4 oz/A; tomato trait override mirrors Sandea. Sweet corn only on hybrids the seed company or Extension has cleared, max 2/3 oz. Clean sprayer before non-corn crops.
